title: Building an HPC Blast Pipeline
author: Bonnie Hurwitz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.d5a82d

steps.title: Create pipeline directories
steps.instruction: mkdir hpc-blast && cd hpc-blast && mkdir std-err std-out data blastdb blast-results scripts

steps.title: Retrieve and build blast database
steps.instruction: cd blastdb && module load irods && iget /iplant/home/shared/imicrobe/projects/43/CAM_PROJ_MarineMicrobes.pep.fa && module load blast && makeblastdb -in CAM_PROJ_MarineMicrobes.pep.fa -dbtype prot && cd ..

steps.title: Download transcriptome FASTA files
steps.instruction: cd data && module load irods && iget SRR006596_day.fasta && iget SRR006597_night.fasta && cd ..

steps.title: Copy Perl scripts to scripts dir
Create config.sh with variables
steps.instruction:
Create a file named config.sh in the hpc-blast directory containing:
#!/bin/bash
export CWD=$PWD
export SCRIPT_DIR="$CWD/scripts"
export FASTA_DIR="$CWD/data"
export STDERR_DIR="$CWD/std-err"
export STDOUT_DIR="$CWD/std-out"
export SPLIT_FA_DIR="$FASTA_DIR/faSplit"
export SPLIT_READ_CT="25000"
export BLAST_OUT_DIR="$CWD/blast-results"
export EVAL="1e-10"
export BLAST="blastx"
export BLASTDB="$CWD/blastdb/CAM_PROJ_MarineMicrobes.pep.fa"

steps.title: Create blast-pipeline.sh driver
steps.instruction:
Create a file named blast-pipeline.sh with the following content:
#!/bin/sh
# Step1: get the env variables and create a list of files
source ./config.sh
# Step 2: get all of the fasta files for input
cd "$FASTA_DIR"
export FILES_LIST="$FASTA_DIR/files-list"
ls *.fasta | sed "s/^\.\/"/ > $FILES_LIST
# Step 3: split the fasta files into smaller chunks
$SCRIPT_DIR/run-fasta-splitter.sh
# Step 4: run blast on each of the file chunks
while read FILE; do
  export FILE="$FILE"
  cd $SPLIT_FA_DIR
  export SPLIT_FILES_LIST="$SPLIT_FA_DIR/split.$FILE"
  ls $FILE.* > $SPLIT_FILES_LIST
  NUM_SPLIT_FILES=$(wc -l $SPLIT_FILES_LIST | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
  # run blast on each of the smaller chunks against a blast database
  JOB_ID1=$(qsub -v SCRIPT_DIR,SPLIT_FA_DIR,BLAST,EVAL,BLASTDB,BLAST_OUT_DIR,FILE -N blast -e "$STDERR_DIR" -o "$STDOUT_DIR" -J 1-$NUM_SPLIT_FILES $SCRIPT_DIR/run-blast.sh)
  # parse the blast results for each of the chunked files
  JOB_ID2=$(qsub -v SCRIPT_DIR,BLAST_OUT_DIR,FILE -W depend=afterany:$JOB_ID1 -e "$STDERR_DIR" -o "$STDOUT_DIR" -J 1-$NUM_SPLIT_FILES $SCRIPT_DIR/run-parse-blast.sh)
 done < $FILES_LIST

steps.title: Create run-fasta-splitter.sh script
steps.instruction:
Create a file named run-fasta-splitter.sh with the following content:
#!/bin/bash
source /usr/share/Modules/init/bash
if [[ ! -d "$SPLIT_FA_DIR" ]]; then
  echo "Cannot find faSplit \"$SPLIT_FA_DIR\""
  mkdir -p $SPLIT_FA_DIR
fi
if [[ ! -e "$FILES_LIST" ]]; then
  echo "Cannot find files list \"$FILES_LIST\""
  exit 1
fi
cd $FASTA_DIR
while read FILE; do
  echo $FILE $SCRIPT_DIR/01-fasta-splitter.pl -n $SPLIT_READ_CT -o $SPLIT_FA_DIR $FILE
  $SCRIPT_DIR/01-fasta-splitter.pl -n $SPLIT_READ_CT -o $SPLIT_FA_DIR $FILE
done < $FILES_LIST

steps.title: Create run-blast.sh script
steps.instruction:
Create a file named run-blast.sh with the following content:
#!/bin/bash
#PBS -W group_list=bhurwitz
#PBS -q windfall
#PBS -l jobtype=cluster_only
#PBS -l select=1:ncpus=2:mem=4gb
#PBS -l place=pack:shared
#PBS -l walltime=24:00:00
#PBS -l cput=24:00:00
#PBS -M youruser@email.arizona.edu
#PBS -m bea
# BLAST parameters
NUM_THREADS=2
DESC=10
ALN=10
MAX_HSPS=10
module load blast
cd "$SPLIT_FA_DIR"
FASTA="$SPLIT_FA_DIR/$FILE.${PBS_ARRAY_INDEX}"
$BLAST -query $FASTA -db $BLASTDB -evalue $EVAL -out $BLAST_OUT_DIR/$FILE.${PBS_ARRAY_INDEX}.blastout -max_hsps $MAX_HSPS -num_descriptions $DESC -num_alignments $ALN -num_threads $NUM_THREADS

steps.title: Create run-parse-blast.sh script
steps.instruction:
Create a file named run-parse-blast.sh with the following content:
#!/bin/bash
#PBS -W group_list=bhurwitz
#PBS -q windfall
#PBS -l jobtype=cluster_only
#PBS -l select=1:ncpus=2:mem=4gb
#PBS -l place=pack:shared
#PBS -l walltime=24:00:00
#PBS -l cput=24:00:00
#PBS -M youruser@email.arizona.edu
#PBS -m bea
module load blast
cd $BLAST_OUT_DIR
BLOUT="$BLAST_OUT_DIR/$FILE.${PBS_ARRAY_INDEX}.blastout"
echo "File \"$FILE.${PBS_ARRAY_INDEX}.blastout\""
$SCRIPT_DIR/04-blast-search.pl $BLOUT > $BLOUT.parsed

steps.title: Modify Perl blast search scripts
Make scripts executable
steps.instruction:
chmod 755 *.sh *.pl
# ensure the driver script is executable as well
chmod 755 blast-pipeline.sh

steps.title: Check output logs
steps.instruction:
cd std-err && ls -1   # should show only zero‑length files
cd ../std-out && ls -l   # should show per‑job compute‑time summaries

steps.title: Add final concatenation step (optional)
steps.instruction:
Create an additional script (or add to blast-pipeline.sh after the parsing step) that concatenates all *.parsed files belonging to the same original FASTA file into a single file, e.g.:
cat $BLAST_OUT_DIR/$FILE.*.parsed > $BLAST_OUT_DIR/$FILE.all.parsed
Run this step on the head node after confirming that all parsing jobs have completed.
